newsitem.title: HONG KONG: TVB hits 12-month high on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: TVB hits 12-month high on earnings hopes.

text.p: Shares of Television Broadcasts Ltd (TVB) hit a 12-month high on Tuesday on demand for laggards and buying in anticipation of better earnings, brokers said.
"Investors switching to laggards following the recent rally in blue-chips fuelled demand," said a sales director at a local brokerage.
Analysts said anticipation of better advertising revenue for TVB, pegged to hopes of a pick-up in consumer spending, underpinned buying.
TVB shares were up HK$1.90 at HK$34.70 in late trade after hitting a high of HK$34.80. Volume was 1.43 million shares worth HK$48.3 million.
Some brokers said speculation that Shaw Brothers (Hong Kong) Ltd would sell some of its 23.5 percent stake in TVB and of the possible spinoff of TVB's overseas production business also helped buying.
Shaw Brothers shares were up HK$0.20 to HK$9.35.
TVB and Shaw Brothers officials were not immediately available for comment.
